#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
Bot: Oh! This place is incredible! It’s so clean…{{wi}} It’s cleaner than our room!
You: That’s just not true. {{wi}}Well…
Maybe it is true, but I refuse to admit it.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: We drove quite far away, is this the nicer part of the megacity?
You: Yes. I paid quite a lot just to get here. They don’t want to let in just anyone here. 
Bot: I see. It’s quite cruel, but I’m sure it wouldn’t look like that if this place was in our neighborhood.
You: No kidding.
If Hobo and the others had means to get here they would scare everyone away. And they would litter…
It’s not like we are any better. The difference in status is staggering. Even the sky is clearer. 
You: Let’s go inside, shall we?
Bot: Sure!
